notes.title: Welcome to Raptor Cliff's!
notes.content:
Pack into the family wagon for a Pacific Northwest road trip to everyone’s favorite attraction: Raptor Cliff’s! This dinosaur-themed adventure park in the coastal redwoods has it all: mini golf, ziplining, hang-gliding... and the friendliest dinos this side of the Triassic period! 🦖 Purchase your Raptor Cliff's park pass today! 🌲
[previewyoutube=90wxLKwy4zE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Course Release[/h2]
[list]
[*] Standard 36 holes, 18 Easy and 18 Hard, with associated lost balls (18) and unique putter
[*] Limited-time "Raptor Cliff's" Welcome Island decorations
[*] 11 course-associated Avatar cosmetics across glasses, hats, heads and outfits
[*] 5 rideable course objects[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/ded5eabe8405f88db4415c1fbf0ff91bc8c85f3d.png[/img]
[h2]Features and Fixes[/h2]
[h3]New: Putter Selection Updates[/h3]
Following the ball tray update in v5.5, our team has revamped our putter selection system!
The new putter display includes a holding rack and introduces pagination to slim down concurrently viewable putters. Most notably, we now display a generic ghost putter for any undiscovered putters; all putters have a hotlink to their associated course, making it easier for players to know which foxhunts they need to complete.
[h3]New: Loading Screen Tips[/h3]
We've added tips and tricks to the Coconut loading screen for your reading pleasure.
[h3]Shack Course Listing Reorganization[/h3]
With the inclusion of more courses in our base game, we have rearranged the Shack course display with an updated front-page view and a new "Classics" listing page.
[h3]Pocket Edition: 'Upside Town' Now Available[/h3]
Players can now putt through this gravity-defying cityscape while on-the-go.
Mobile Players, ICYMI: Check out our new 'Standard Mode' gameplay!
Standard Mode is our new vertical-only, non-gyro mode that relies purely on swipe-and-tap and pinch/pull motion for players to navigate and play. This mode sets players into a locked camera position behind the ball and allows for a smooth, casual gameplay experience.
[h3]ICYMI: New Activities and Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New slingshot stands are available in Sweetopia 🍭 and Zerzura 🏜️
[*] New player scale and gravity customizations for Tourist Trap 🏴‍☠️[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/4f971d9ccb1b56239b99974001c490c60857921d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Attention Golfers[/h3]
We advise golfers visiting Sweetopia to ensure their equipment is clean of confections upon exiting the course, lest they attract pests!
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Our team does their best to address bugs and fixes between course releases and updates.
[list]
[*] Upside Town: Pizza Rat and city pigeons better respond to player movement triggers
[*] Mount Olympus H18: Made adjustments to the playable greens to remove ball timeouts[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/9f8f777ca3160a88f87bf2e6811d47ca6775b362.jpg[/img]
[b]We appreciate your support! [/b]Our team is working through other known bug fixes and feature updates as we continue to build courses and expand on all that Walkabout offers.
[i]Experiencing a bug? You can report it through our official [url=discord.gg/wmg]Discord[/url] server, either in the bug report channel or Bug Threads, or email us at wmgsupport@mightycoconut.com. You can also ask our community members and Moderators for help! [u]When reporting a bug[/u], be sure to include your device type and platform of choice, as well as a detailed description of the bug encountered and any screenshots or video recordings; this information will help our team to better identify and reproduce the issue for resolution.[/i]
[h2]Buy and Play[/h2]
Players must update to the latest 5.8 version of Walkabout Mini Golf to maintain gameplay and multiplayer functionality.

notes.title: Mount Olympus - Ascend Now!
notes.content:
High above the Aegean Sea lies the legendary realm of the Greek gods and goddesses where they meet to determine the fate of mortals—through an epic miniature golf odyssey! Will your skills be sharp enough to satisfy the Olympian Council or are you destined to face the wrath of the gods? Enter the realm of the Greek gods, and shape the destiny of mortals below in Mount Olympus, available now! ⛰️
[previewyoutube=RvNP4MrhOE0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Course Release
[/b]Standard 36 holes, 18 Easy and 18 Hard, with associated lost balls (18) and putter
Limited time, Ancient Greek-inspired Welcome Island decoration
10 new Avatar cosmetics across hair, hats, outfits, and heads
[b]Features and Fixes[/b]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Attention guests: Stop using employee equipment!
[*] We've heard reports of golfers trespassing into storage areas and pilfering yard care equipment... we kindly ask guests to keep activity restricted to the golfing greens. Thank you!
[*] Arizona Modern Lighting Upgrade 🌵
[*] The Sonoran Desert is awash in light and shadow, with a revamped lighting upgrade to both the Easy and Hard version of Arizona Modern.
[*] Grip-to-Putter 3 Available Now 🏌️
[*] We've partnered with FormX Design for the latest iteration of Grip-to-Putter controller attachments! Our Mount Olympus DLC release will update the custom settings page with a new v3 calibration preset and in-game wristband cosmetic to accompany the Grip-to-Putter 3 accessory. Grip-to-Putter 3 is available for Quest 2/3/3S and soon, PSVR2.
[*] Legacy preset calibrations for v1 and v2 Grip-to-Putters will still be available through the Welcome Island Shack settings menu.
[*] ICYMI: Slingshots are now installed in Shangri-La! 🥮 
[*] Over shadowy chasms and between a maze of bridges, players can now enjoy the meditative act of target practice in the Himalayas.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/243bf7d4be392be0a4d2758fd75a1af0dcadc0c8.png[/img]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievement hunters rejoice! We've fixed the Amateur Status, Target Master, & Iron Putter PSVR2 trophies.
[*] Controller smoothing can now be used while custom calibration settings are enabled
[*] Our team made some fixes across the Viva las Elvis course, the most notable being:
[*] H13: Ball now stays inside the slot machine and correctly rolls down the chute
[*] H14: The scorecard and wrist display now show the same, correct scoring
[*] H18: The ball will now consistently sink into the cup when putted into the final area
[*] Our team is still working with Meta to address the underlying cause of putter hitching and tracking reports we've been receiving. While we continue to work through this issue, we have added a new 'Putter Tracking Guard' toggle in the Settings menu, under the Putter tab. When the toggle is enabled, the putter head becomes disabled if poor tracking/performance is detected, in order to minimize errant or inaccurate putts. We have also made under-the-hood fixes to address performance and clean-up. 
[*] Please note: Any "hitching" or tracking issues that may arise during gameplay have the potential to come from OS updates, environmental factors (lighting, reflections, etc.) and device performance issues. We recommend you try out troubleshooting steps first and review the latest "Putter Glitch" blog on the Walkabout Mini Golf Updates page.
[*] ... & other bugs addressing minor visual and gameplay bugs across our course catalog
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/bc6e6d26968e622cddf248eefbf5bbe9a2ad5558.png[/img]
We appreciate your support! Our team is working through other bug fixes and feature updates as we continue to expand all that Walkabout offers.
Experiencing a bug? Go ahead and report it through our official Discord server, either in the bug report channel or Bug Threads, or email us at wmgsupport@mightycoconut.com. You can ask our community members and Moderators for help! When reporting a bug, be sure to include your device type and platform of choice, as well as a detailed description of the bug encountered and any screenshots or video recordings; this information will help our team to better identify and repro the issue.

[b]Buy and Play
[/b]Players must update to the latest 5.7 version of Walkabout Mini Golf to ensure gameplay and multiplayer functionality.

notes.title: Viva Las Vegas - Out Now!
notes.content:
Join the entourage of the one and only 'King of Rock 'n' Roll' as a world of neon comes to life in "Viva Las Elvis,” a 70s-era casino fever-dream bursting with iconic moments inspired by Elvis Presley’s legendary lyrics and unforgettable films. Dust off your cape, put on your jumpsuit, and prepare to putt through the swankiest spot in Vegas! 🎸

[previewyoutube=dy97zqruGdY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Course Release & Game Updates
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Standard 36 holes (18 easy, 18 hard) with themed lost balls and a commemorative putter.
[*] Elvis-inspired Avatar cosmetics and Elvis' head (12 total items).
[*] Original score by Chris Reyman featuring "The VLE Band”—live musicians performing a tribute composition highlighting the spirit of Elvis’ 60s/70s rock 'n' roll.
[*] Interactable musical instruments and working course microphones.
[*] Limited-time "Viva Las Elvis" Welcome Island decoration.
[*] ICYMI: Our last mini-update introduced Slingshot Challenges on Tourist Trap, Cherry Blossom, and Alfheim! Our previous game update introduced the new ball sorting tray at the Welcome Island Shack, with by-course organization and a quick-select "Last Played" ball section.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/92f70336bcb0c0e25ace02a467847eebfe48b571.png[/img]
[h2]Fixes
[/h2]
Our team has made adjustments throughout some of the DLC and base game to add quality-of-life updates and needed fixes, so that as we expand Walkabout we don't compromise on quality or polish. Among other fixes the most notable updates are:
[list]
[*] Course record pop-up notifications should fire off properly.
[*] Improvements for better score preservation upon a headset disconnect/rejoin in multiplayer rooms.
[*] Golfers can restart a round more than once and play through normally.
[*] Myst hole 9, where the bridge would not sync/un-sync properly in multiplayer rooms, should be properly updated and functional.
[*] We appreciate your support! Our team is working through other fixes and feature updates as we expand our course catalog and game offerings.
[/list]
Experiencing a bug? Go ahead and report it through our official Discord server, either in the bug report channel or Bug Threads, or email us at wmgsupport@mightycoconut.com. Be sure to include your device type and platform of choice, as well as a detailed description of the bug encountered, and any screenshots or video recordings; this information will help our team to better identify and repro the issue.

[h2]Buy & Play[/h2]
Players must update to the latest 5.6 version of the Walkabout Mini Golf game app (regardless of if they purchase the latest DLC course) to ensure gameplay and multiplayer functionality.

Happy golfing! ⛳

notes.title: 8-Bit Lair - Out Now!👾
notes.content:
[b][h3]Evil Lairs DLC Series: 8-Bit Lair
[/h3][/b]
Get ready to log-on and tee-off! It's the totally gnarly third installment of our Villain’s Lair series: 8-Bit Lair. Traverse a wicked corporate skyscraper, global headquarters of Vincent Vector, hacker billionaire and spoiled genius. Will you be able to stop his bogus plot to shred the physical world and bring it all into his vast Virtual Reality? Find out in this radical '80s mini golf adventure. Challenge yourself and your buds to retro brick-breaking fun, diabolical boss showdowns, and new dimensions of pixelated pandemonium.

notes.title: Mars Gardens DLC Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Course Description[/h1]
Fifty years after landing on Mars, humanity has mastered horticulture and mini-golf in Mars Gardens, a thriving bio-dome community cultivating oversized crops in a unique low-gravity environment. Find solace on the Red Planet's new greens in Walkabout Mini Golf's latest DLC installment, Mars Gardens, available for purchase now.
[previewyoutube=HsVmh-DTzbs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Release Notes
[/h1]Standard 36 holes (18 Easy, 18 Hard) with associated lost balls (18) and Foxhunt putter
Martian and agrarian-inspired Avatar cosmetics (7 Total)
Mars Low-gravity Custom Toggle (*See 'Features & Fixes for details)
[h2]Features & Fixes
[/h2]
[h3]Mars Garden Course: Low-gravity Mode[/h3]
Ground Control to Major Tom, golf balls are clear for takeoff with our new Low-gravity Custom setting! Users can find this course modifier listed under the 'Custom' tab on the course selection window, with a toggle for Normal and Low gravity settings. This setting is only available to play on the Mars Gardens course.
Note: Course records will not save while using a course modifier (e.g. Low-gravity). Active course modifiers will be listed on the expanded course scorecard view, by clicking on the scorecard's lower righthand 3 dots.
[h3]Game Modes Rejoin Behavior Updates
[/h3]Our team has added support for re-joining Race Mode and Match Mode sessions.
[h3]Course Reset Button
[/h3]Want to hit replay? Players can now restart a course without exiting to Main Menu! Navigate to the 'Reset Course' button through the course scorecard view, under the 'Course' tab.
Note: This setting is only available in single-player rounds.
[h3]Pico Fixes
[/h3]Putting haptics have been repaired.
[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
[h3]PSVR2[/h3]
Our team is aware of save data issues that some PSVR2 players are experiencing and has a planned patch fix coming soon. We truly appreciate your patience with our team as we continue to work toward a resolution.
[h3]General[/h3]
Our team is aware of varying bugs that continue to occur intermittently for players. We're committed to investing in not just the expansion of the game, but its integrity, and we do our best to bring under-the-hood fixes and quality-of-life updates alongside our paid content when we can. We appreciate user bug reports and are continuing to investigate and repair various reported issues.

[b][i]Players must update to the latest 5.3 version of the Walkabout game (regardless of if they purchase the latest DLC course) to ensure gameplay and multiplayer functionality[/i].[/b]

notes.title: Wallace & Gromit” DLC Out Now!
notes.content:
Our team is chuffed to announce that our collaboration with Aardman in the “Wallace & Gromit” Walkabout course is now available for purchase! Take your tee-time with tea as you putt through 62 West Wallaby Street and delight at the contraptions, mechanisms, and obstacles throughout. [b]Fun fact: “Wallace & Gromit” contains more animations and sound design than any previous Walkabout course! [/b]Crack on!

[previewyoutube=73vnwJd4ZB4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]W&G Course Release[/b]
[list]
[*] Standard 36 Holes (18 Easy, 18 Hard) with associated lost balls & Foxhunt putter
[*] Have your cheese and eat it too with our “Wallace & Gromit” themed Avatars! (x3)
[/list]

[b]Updates and Fixes[/b]
Avatar UI Updates 👒
We’ve made some UI changes to the Avatar section of the Shack, allowing players to see all Avatar cosmetics (even unowned ones) and purchase either the associated DLC or standalone Avatar Pack, if you don’t own it already. Owned Avatar cosmetics will appear first, followed by unowned pieces.

[b]Driving Range and Scorecard Updates 🎯[/b]
Our new 'All Targets' mode allows players to time how long it takes to hit all of our practice targets; some targets have had tweaks to their placement and sizing. This update also expands scorecard information, which now shows the player name on the expanded view of the course scorecard. This is viewable by entering God Mode to view the course scores, and then clicking the bottom right-hand 3 dots on the card.

[b]Guest Pass Bug Fix 🪲[/b]
Our Guest Pass system had a bug in the previous release that allowed players to collect lost balls and complete Foxhunts while utilizing Guest Pass. This has now been fixed. Note: Collectibles earned within this bug window will NOT be removed from player inventory.

Play "Wallace and Gromit"
Players must update to the latest 5.2 version of the Walkabout game (regardless of if they purchase the latest DLC course) to ensure multiplayer and gameplay functionality.

Happy golfing! ⛳

notes.title: Cherry Blossom Remaster & Game Modes Out Now! 🌸
notes.content:
Our team has been hard at work for over a year to refactor our base game code, allowing us to develop and innovate exciting additions to the game that will fundamentally enhance playstyle. We are pleased to announce our new Game Modes included in all courses, alongside our expansive remaster of Cherry Blossom, is out now. This update is free of cost for all players.
[h3][b]Cherry Blossom Remaster[/b][/h3]
Rediscover your Zen by revisiting our Cherry Blossom course in full bloom.
Additions include:
[list]
[*] Updates and expansions to lighting, environment, creatures, interactables, and more.
[*] Select instruments have haptics and audio hookups.
[*] Fox Hunt clue changes to adapt with environment changes
[/list]
[h3][b]Game Modes[/b][/h3]
[b]New Gameplay Styles[/b]

[b]Walkabout Match Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Enjoy Walkabout’s spin on Matchplay! The player with the lowest score on a hole gets a point– players can tie for points. Most points wins.
[*] Note: Players who intentionally leave a Match cannot re-enter. Our team is developing more safety nets for players who accidentally disconnect.
[/list]
[b]Race Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will putt simultaneously to see who can complete the course the quickest!
[*] Note: Players cannot join a race late, and will be put into Observer mode.
[/list]
[b]Custom[/b]
[list]
[*] Choose your own game mode, holes and turn order.
[/list]
[h3]New Turn Orders[/h3]
[b]Honors (Standard)[/b]
[list]
[*] The player who scored lowest on the previous hole gets to putt first on the next.
[/list]
[b]Distance[/b]
[list]
[*] Whoever is furthest away from the hole gets to putt first.
[/list]
[b]Simultaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can golf simultaneously in traditional strokeplay rounds as well as Race Mode. Simultaneous turn order is not available for Match Mode.
[*] Note: Due to technical and design constraints, we don't have any current plans for supporting real-time multiplayer ball collisions.
[/list]
[h3]General Walkabout Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have added new UI changes to our wrist display, Welcome Island shack, and scorecards.
[/list]
[h3]Build Numbers[/h3]
Users must update to the 5.1 version of our game to maintain a smooth gameplay experience and to utilize multiplayer rounds together. [u]Given the extent of this update, it will NOT be backward compatible with older build versions.[/u]
[b]Quest / Rift: 5.1[/b] | 27604
[b]SteamVR: 5.1[/b] | 27604
[b]PICO: 5.1[/b] | 27604
[b]PSVR2:[/b] 27604

We thank everyone who supports WMG and golf with us. Good luck on the greens!

notes.title: New DLC Destination, Venice - Out Now!
notes.content:
Canals, fountains, piazzas, historic corridors; [b]such delights can be found in our brand new DLC destination, Venice![/b]
https://youtu.be/J0aYGXGQGvU
Marvel at the “Adriatic Jewel” while putting through 18 holes in Easy and 18 on Hard Mode, collecting expertly-hidden lost balls, and completing our foxhunt to unlock a custom artisanal putter. Che capolavoro!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/a6190797949e63b5c00f7e8d2366db28cc735a50.jpg[/img]
Stand out in style too by fashioning your choice of delectable or dashing avatar accessory, hand-crafted behind the doors of the finest local ateliers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/accd00dae8bbd3113d47298ac24e8eb437f062ab.jpg[/img]
[u][b]You can also find the following game updates and fixes alongside this release[/b][/u]
- New accessibility features to assist players, including a magnifier, large wrist UI, and smoothed controller motion.
- New clam avatar colors (no longer just purple). Linguine alle vongole, anyone?
- PSVR2 Atlantis game crash fix for some users when returning to Welcome Island from both Easy and Hard.
- Ice Lair fixes for record showing as “?0” in Welcome Island, a ball fix for being considered in-play when falling into grates (now considered as falling out-of-bounds and ball returns to previous position), and a fix for the ball being able to slide off final Ramp after making it into the hole.  
- A Myst Easy/Hard fix for when the sky starts dark at Hole 11 Easy - the workaround of going into the scorecard and back no longer works. The sky is staying dark.
- A Journey to the Center of the Earth fix for headlamp setting not always initializing properly in Hard Mode (if previously enabled, the light at times would show from your putter instead of your head). 
- A Quest fix for DLCs not being available when disconnected from WiFi after Meta v62 SDK update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/89ba1fd505590fe49190ec7db4afaa3a539e2684.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Fantastico! How do I play? [/b][/u]
Simply update your passport and take a passeggiata to our Steam page below to purchase. Be sure to join in the celebrations on Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok too.

[u][b]How can I find other Italian speakers?[/b][/u]
Italian language rooms have been set up for Venice Easy, running for 2 weeks after launch for locals to “socializzare”. The rooms open at 9 am and 5 pm local Italian time on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, so be sure to join our Discord server for more information.

Till next time, ciao!

notes.title: Ice Lair DLC - Out Now!
notes.content:
Carved into an arctic glacier lies a subterranean hideout cloaking an ice-cold plot against humanity. Stop an evil scientist and her puffin henchmen intent on perfecting their freeze ray technology.

[previewyoutube=E4Rzkcjga7o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What is Ice Lair you might ask? Here’s the full frosty itinerary.[/b]

In this next installment of the Evil Lair series, your mission is to putt through the icy headquarters of a former scientist mastermind as you attempt to stop her colony of puffin henchmen intent on perfecting their freeze ray technology…

Putt through 18 holes in Easy and 18 on Hard Mode with over 150 puffins as nosey on-lookers, collect lost balls, and complete our most challenging foxhunt yet to enjoy our custom frozen putter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/eed36bf976cacb2a78767f305c5b7105a8daccc8.jpg[/img]

[b]We’re giddy with ant-ice-ipation. What else is there?[/b]

This course introduces 4 new gameplay mechanics:
[list]
[*]A freeze ray to turn a player’s ball into an ice cube.
[*]There are heat pads over which frozen balls can be melted!
[*]Ice on the green for frozen and unfrozen balls to traverse.
[*]Players can now jump frozen balls over obstacles and barriers.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/9876ce102da9925582fd76533d51a5942d0420b0.jpg[/img]

[b]Surely that’s just the tip of the iceberg? [/b][list]

[*]You’re right! Enjoy 2 new game-wide course settings with this DLC release, including a “Forfeit Hole” (found under Settings > Course), and “Auto Teleport” (found under Settings > Movement).
[*]Dive into updates in the main menu avatar tab, with avatar presets being reorganized to display custom avatars first, followed by predesigned avatars (eg: Ludo, Clam, Robot). 
[*]We’re saying so long to the dark blue hair, and introducing a gray hair replacement instead! Light blue hair is still available and PERFECT for this icy backdrop.
[*]There are 25th-course celebratory avatars - a top hat and crown - included in the new update regardless of Ice Lair purchase. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/88e7b35bf5ebe84f29c75026fda66a97b59b08d4.jpg[/img]

For the first time too, there are additional surfaces the frozen ball can stay “in play” on for added trick shots and tricky workarounds to evil obstacles! Not only that, but there are tons of technical tricks to emulate frozen air, icy water, and the sea life that surrounds the arctic compound. Perfect for the dozens upon dozens of puffins who watch and interact with you, and for the rideable orca whale watching! 

[b]Note: Ice Lair release will not be backwards compatible for Multiplayer. Please join us on [url=discord.gg/wmg]Discord[/url] to discuss this further. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/3b8dc157062518ccbc8ccda918e99f68c7756420.jpg[/img]

[b]Okay I’m ready! How do I play? [/b]

By heading over to our Steam page below, of course! Snow time like the present! Be sure to join in the chilly celebrations on [url=https://twitter.com/WalkaboutMG]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf]Facebook[/url], and[url=https://www.instagram.com/] Instagram. [/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790080/Walkabout_Mini_Golf_Ice_Lair/

notes.title: Brand New Holiday Update!? Sleigh, What?!
notes.content:
Oh the weather outside may be frightful, but in Walkabout Mini Golf, it’s anything but! 

After all, [b]we’ve maxed out our holiday cheer with this brand new update, decking our digital halls with a festive jingle, holiday avatars, and more[/b]. So, let’s break the ice and show you what’s in store!

[b][u]Wintry Welcome Island Takeover[/u][/b]

Sleigh bells are ringing on Welcome island with [b]a brand new holiday jingle[/b], composed by Coconut composer Chris Reyman! Use it as a backdrop when gathering with family and friends throughout the festive season, or use for content creation, dressed in one of our brand new holiday avatars.

[u][b]Holiday Avatars[/b][/u]

From dolls to dinosaur skulls, 2023 has been THE year for avatars, but we’re not done yet! Fright and delight your loved ones with our [b]horned Krampus avatar[/b], and serenade that special someone with our [b]mistletoe on a stick.[/b] Our [b]New Years glasses[/b] too, make the perfect accessory as you count down to 2024 with friends near and far. So what are you waiting for? Jump into Walkabout and see why these new avatars are TRULY love at frost sight.

[u][b]Meow Wolf Hole 18 Update[/b][/u]

You reported, and we listened! Alongside this wintry wonderland of updates, comes a fix for Meow Wolf’s Hole 18. For the few that kindly reported this issue to us, thank you, and be sure to portal jump once again into our latest DLC, to see your Hole 18 score soar.

So from all of us here at Walkabout Mini Golf, happy holidays! And do share the festive cheer with others on [url=twitter.com/walkaboutmg]X[/url], [url=instagram.com/walkaboutminigolf]Instagram[/url], [url=facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf]Facebook[/url], and [url=discord.gg/wmg]Discord.[/url]

Till 2024, 
Mighty Coconut

notes.title: Meow Wolf DLC Portal Open Now!
notes.content:
The portal has opened - experience Numina from wherever you are for the very first time, with our BRAND NEW Meow Wolf DLC!

[previewyoutube=18x2GjV47lQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Putt through portals of possibility to score and explore a wondrous, kaleidoscopic, experimental world of fun-filled play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/8dcc0bb0b536b1dfe7c418d217e239316d0e3d31.png[/img]
The new course includes 18 Easy Mode and 18 Hard Mode holes, collectible golf balls to seek out in-game, a commemorative putter, Meow Wolf-themed avatars for dressing up in the course and anywhere in Walkabout Mini Golf, and is teeming with familiar and new Meow Wolf creatures, colorful flora, mysterious portals, and more gameplay mechanics than any other course to date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799938/c0342f2866f499fbe659b98dc4c375470622f932.png[/img]
This virtual love letter to Meow Wolf Denver's Convergence Station, is thanks to the collaboration between Caity Kennedy, Co-Founder and Creative Director of Meow Wolf, and the team here at Mighty Coconut. 

“Numina is a benevolent, multiversal being that is interpreting mini golf and virtual reality as just another set of beings, physics and spaces to play within. This expansive space provides a spectrum of new ways to create and play in near limitless expressions and I am curious to see how people come together here for new, transformational experiences from near and far!”

You can also see Meow Wolf Co-Founder Vince Kadublek's welcome transmission to Meow Wolf below. 

[previewyoutube=UDgCmPvrMes;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][u]Release Notes In Full[/u][/b]

- 36 new holes on Meow Wolf - 18 easy, 18 hard
- New Avatar customizations
- Under-the-hood fixes for past courses; future fixes planned!
- This course features 57 species of plant, all of which were designed, modeled from scratch, colored, and placed by hand. Fun fact: The portion of our polygon budget devoted to plant life is 60%, the most it has ever been.
- 12 unique, named character rigs, 33 animated creatures altogether.
- Quest 1 sunsetting (now no longer backwards compatible). Quest 1 users will be locked to multiplayer with other Quest 1 devices only. [url=https://www.mightycoconut.com/quest1]Red our blog for more information. [/url]
- Quest 3 optimization with updated Quest 3 performance and visual optimization to 90Htz.

So pick up our brand new DLC now, and be sure to follow us on [url=Twitter.com/walkaboutminigolf]X[/url], [url=Facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf]Facebook[/url], and [url=Instagram.com/walkaboutminigolf]Instagram[/url] for the latest course announcements. [url=Discord.gg/wmg]Join our Discord community too[/url] for tips and tricks, events, and prompt support via our ticketing system.

So grab your headset and step into Meow Wolf, now open, if you are…

notes.title: 2.8 HOTFIX
notes.content:
New add-on course: "Gardens of Babylon."
Cloud save
Player Profiles: There are now 6 save slots for people sharing a headset
Localization: We now support English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese and Korean.
Bug fixes and performance improvements

HOTFIX UPDATE: This update should address issues some PC players have had accessing DLC, as well as a few minor things around profile, cloud saves and connectivity.

This hotfix also includes a RESTORE DATA button at the bottom of the profiles panel. This will try to retrieve whatever local data was stored from the previous version of the game, and put it in a new profile. So if you had multiple people playing on multiple devices, you should be able to create new profiles for each of them by clicking that button on each device.

notes.title: Walkabout Mini Golf - Out Now on SteamVR!
notes.content:
After almost a year on Oculus, 7 unique courses and 120 lost golf balls, Walkabout Mini Golf has now landed on the greens of SteamVR!

[previewyoutube=bzFXNoMkCR0;full][/previewyoutube]
With so many challenging holes and immersive lanes, including those on the recently released Bogey’s Bonanza course, Walkabout Mini Golf proudly sits at the the #2 spot for the best-rated game on Oculus Quest! Which is why it was only natural to turn to releasing the same game on SteamVR, for many more passionate putters to enjoy. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38799938/26682168efbbf9d95795ed7ed1bab454067d4390.png[/img]

[b]Features: [/b]

- Full crossplay between all platforms.
- A multiplayer version with up to 5 players.
- Challenging bonus levels.
- 7 unique 18-hole courses to master.
- Unlockable Night Mode for more challenging versions of all courses.
- Accurate physics that feel just like the real thing.
- Over 120 custom balls hidden throughout the courses.
- Smooth locomotion and teleporting options.
- An ability to fly!
- Foxhunts, available to complete to unlock special putters.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38799938/6574207c52f217c14d0063097ea303ca9bb4d3f1.png[/img]

Follow us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wmg]Discord[/url] to set up multiplayer matches, join tournaments or gain SteamVR advice and support from our awesome community and moderators!

You can also be the first to hear about game updates on [url=https://twitter.com/mighty_coconut?lang=en]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/walkaboutminigolf/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/walkaboutminigolf/]Facebook[/url]. 

Look forward to seeing you all on the green! 

The Mighty Coconut team
